title: 第一卷 第13章 听财务的
slug: 全网黑上恋综后我爆红了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

弹幕已经疯成一片。

【啊啊啊啊他让她别吃不好吃的饼，吃馄饨！】

【这什么温柔版下班文学。】

【宋尔尔你别嘴硬了，你刚才停顿了！】

【陆执不是来恋综的，他是来精准投喂的。】

【疑似好人哈哈哈哈哈。】

第一项任务完成后，工作人员提醒第二项。

“接下来，两位需要完成一次情侣互动小游戏。”

宋尔尔立刻警觉。

“什么游戏？”

工作人员拿出一张卡片，读道：“夜市套圈，两位需要共同套中一个指定奖品，成功后可获得节目组额外二十元经费。”

宋尔尔眼睛亮了。

“额外二十？”

工作人员点头：“是的。”

宋尔尔：“早说啊！什么情侣互动，这是创收项目。”

陆执：“你很有动力。”

宋尔尔：“那是相当！二十块在夜市可以买一份豪华版烤冷面。”

陆执：“那走吧。”

套圈摊前围着不少人。

摊主见到摄像机，立刻招呼：“来来来，十块钱十个圈，套中就拿走！”

工作人员说明任务：“节目组已经和摊主沟通过，两位需要用十个圈套中那只黄色小鸭玩偶。”

宋尔尔看向指定奖品。

一只巴掌大的黄色鸭子，摆在第二排中间。

距离不近，也不算太远。

她看向陆执：“陆老师，你准吗？”

陆执：“还行。”

宋尔尔：“还行是多行？”

陆执：“看目标。”

宋尔尔：“目标二十块经费。”

陆执点头：“那很重要。”

宋尔尔把十个圈拿在手里，分给他五个。

“我们一人五个，你先来。”

陆执接过圈，站到线后。

他没怎么瞄，第一圈就套中了小鸭旁边的杯子。

围观路人惊呼。

宋尔尔鼓掌：“很准，但准偏了。”

陆执：“再来。”

第二圈擦着小鸭过去。

第三圈套中了后面的塑料花。

宋尔尔皱眉：“陆老师，你是不是对小鸭有意见？”

陆执看她：“风向问题。”

宋尔尔抬头看了看。

夜市里根本没风。

她点头：“懂，强者从不承认手滑。”

陆执第四圈出手，终于套中了小鸭的脑袋。

圈挂了一下，又滑下来。

宋尔尔倒吸一口气：“鸭子拒绝了你。”

陆执：“看出来了。”

第五圈，陆执稳稳套中。

围观路人鼓掌。

工作人员刚要宣布成功，摊主却说：“哎这个只套到脖子，得整个圈落地才算。”

宋尔尔看向摊主。

Page (1/3)

The barrage has gone crazy.

[Ah ah ah ah, he told her not to eat the unpalatable pancakes but to eat wontons instead!】

[What kind of gentle version of off-duty literature is this?】

[Song Er'er, please stop being so tough, you just paused!】

[Lu Zhi is not here to love Zong, he is here to feed accurately.】

[Suspected to be a good guy hahahahaha.】

After the first task is completed, the staff reminds the second task.

"Next, you two need to complete a couple interactive game."

Song Er'er immediately became alert.

"What game?"

The staff took out a card and read: "Night market trap, two people need to jointly win a designated prize. If successful, they will receive an additional twenty yuan from the program team."

Song Er'er's eyes lit up.

"Twenty extra?"

The staff nodded: "Yes."

Song Er'er: "Tell me earlier! What kind of couple interaction? This is an income-generating project."

Lu Zhi: "You are very motivated."

Song Er'er: "That's quite a deal! You can buy a deluxe version of grilled cold noodles at the night market for twenty yuan."

Lu Zhi: "Let's go then."

There were many people surrounding the ring stall.

When the stall owner saw the camera, he immediately greeted him: "Come on, come on, ten rings for ten dollars, if you hit one, take it away!"

The staff explained the task: "The program team has communicated with the stall owner that the two of you need to use the yellow duck doll in the ten traps."

Song Er'er looked at the designated prize.

A palm-sized yellow duck is placed in the middle of the second row.

Not too close, not too far either.

She looked at Lu Zhi: "Teacher Lu, are you accurate?"

Lu Zhi: "Not bad."

Song Er'er: "It's okay or more?"

Lu Zhi: "Look at the target."

Song Er'er: "Target 20 yuan of funding."

Lu Zhi nodded: "That's very important."

Song Er'er took ten circles in his hand and gave him five.

"There are five of us each, you come first."

Lu Zhi took over the circle and stood behind the line.

He didn't take much aim and hit the cup next to the duck in the first circle.

onlookers exclaimed.

Song Er'er applauded: "It's accurate, but it's wrong."

Lu Zhi: "Come again."

The second circle passed by the duckling.

The third trap hit the plastic flower at the back.

Song Er'er frowned: "Teacher Lu, do you have any objections to the little duck?"

Lu Zhi looked at her: "It's a question of wind direction."

Song Er'er looked up.

There was no wind at all in the night market.

She nodded: "I understand, a strong man never admits that his hands are slippery."

Lu Zhi took action in the fourth round and finally hit the duck's head.

The loop hung up for a moment, then slipped down again.

Song Er'er took a breath: "The duck rejected you."

Lu Zhi: "I can see it."

On the fifth lap, Lu Zhi made a sure win.

Onlookers applauded.

Just as the staff was about to declare success, the stall owner said: "Hey, this only covers the neck, the whole circle has to fall to the ground."

Song Er'er looked at the stall owner.
